newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Casino advised bidding reopened.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Casino advised bidding reopened.

text.p: Hollywood Casino Corp said Friday that the Louisiana Gaming Control Board has told it that it will reopen the bidding process for the final riverboat gaming license in that state.
The move comes after DeBartolo Entertainment Louisiana Gaming Inc, which is Hollywood's joint venture partner, decided to withdraw from the casino portion of the proposed project.
Both companies won the license March 13 for their proposed Cane's Landing project in Bossier City.
Hollywood said the gaming board has invited it to resubmit an application for the license.

"We believe the Board maintains a favorable view of the Hollywood project in Bossier City. The board of directors of Hollywood will re-evaluate the situation and determine our position," Hollywood Casino said in a statement Friday evening.
